answer: One still photo cannot prove a body occupied only one path. This gate assigns each applicant a surveyed transect that starts in a fenced meadow, crosses a marked dune, and ends at a bolted basalt post whose serial is laser-etched. The walker films a continuous take while dropping numbered tags; clerks post commit=keccak256(addr||post_serial||tag_hashes||path_hash). The survey fee is 0.41 POA; 14 POA stays locked for eight epochs. Peers replay the tape against official waypoints. A reused post, spliced path, or matching tag sequence forfeits the lock and mutes both keys for eleven epochs.
